completion_summary: AI is driving major changes across industries — from healthcare to finance — by enabling more sophisticated applications that process vast amounts of data in real time. These advances let organizations extract insights, automate decisions, and improve outcomes, but they also raise important ethical issues: models can reproduce or amplify bias, and their complexity often undermines transparency and accountability. Addressing these challenges requires better dataset practices, fairness-aware model design, explainability tools, and governance (policy, auditing, and human oversight) to ensure AI systems are both effective and trustworthy.
